arguments.text: Describes driving ability, not an out-of-court assertion, failing 801(c) definition.
Prior test failures prove conduct, not a declarant's statement truth.
If based on an instructor's report, it is an out-of-court statement for truth.
Character rules govern propensity, not hearsay, as reliability is irrelevant.
Proving negligence requires establishing truth of the matter, triggering 801(c).
Mere observations of driving skill lack the assertive element required by 801(c).
